entries.claim: The bounded read-only service holds its admission, latency, and response bounds.
entries.environment: single local machine, CPython, no network
entries.limitations: Laptop-scale measurements from one process. Not a service level objective, a capacity claim, or evidence of production readiness.
entries.sample_context: aggregate percentiles over synthetic request scenarios

entries.claim: The console meets its resource budgets, renders every honest state, and passes accessibility checks across four browser targets.
entries.collection_method: scripts/collect_console_evidence.py from real build and test runs
entries.environment: single local machine, Node 24 toolchain, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit
entries.limitations: Measured on one machine. Panel 4 of the figure is a static property of the view sources, not a claim about which states were exercised.
entries.sample_context: 130 browser tests, 172 unit tests, 3 measured budgets

entries.claim: The release dry run verifies end to end and refuses six deliberate tamper cases.
entries.collection_method: scripts/collect_release_evidence.py against a non-publishing dry run
entries.limitations: Digests establish content identity, not economic validity, independent review, or production readiness. No signing material exists yet.
entries.sample_context: 24 release subjects, 439 SBOM components, 6 tamper cases

entries.claim: Two clean builds of one commit produce byte-identical release artifacts.
entries.environment: single local machine; one platform only
entries.limitations: Cross-platform byte identity is not established, and the container image is not yet a dry-run subject.

entries.claim: The date-block bootstrap holds its nominal false-positive rate under intraday dependence where a naive per-forecast bootstrap does not.
entries.environment: single local machine, seeded numpy generator
entries.limitations: Simulated evidence. It establishes the estimator's operating characteristics, not any model's performance, and is not market evidence.
entries.sample_context: 400 synthetic null cohorts per dependence level, seed 20260811

entries.claim: The Signal Foundry dataset contract round-trips a verified historical panel with recorded provenance.
entries.environment: single local machine, immutable verified cache, zero provider requests
entries.limitations: Stale current-vintage public-domain data through 2018-03-27. Not a point-in-time universe, and vulnerable to survivorship and selection bias.
entries.sample_context: aggregate counts and hashes only; raw rows remain local

entries.claim: Deterministic cache replay reproduces an acquired panel without a provider request.
entries.environment: single local machine, cache-first, no network
entries.limitations: Replay of already-acquired data. Establishes mechanics, not data quality.
